summary: Aella says she would welcome a pause on AI and works to bring AI risk to mainstream audiences, after years of finding it hard to make sense of.

statements.quote: You need to understand that we are not even playing in the same ballpark when it comes to superintelligence.
I mean, in the sense that it would be great if we could pause AI, yeah.
The world doesn’t understand the magnitude of the thing that is being built right now by a small handful of companies.
I really want people to go into action, as opposed to anxiety.
Making sense of AI risk is very hard for me.
statements.venue: Essay, My attempts to sensemake AI risk
